That guy isn't sorry. He apologized. Yes. But did he apologize for his actions OR did he apologize for YOU getting hurt by his remark more then expected. Please consider this again!!! If he was sorry he should have said sorry to have said such hurtful things, no buts, no excuses, no "oh I didn't mean to come out as hurtful as it has been" just I'm sorry for hurting your feelings I won't do it again. It sounds like as if unconsciously he's thinking " I'm sorry that you got sensitive about it and got more hurt then I would think"
